name: wf-L27

name: wf-L01
delta: A single ordinary customer, small, stands at a clean teal-and-cream American bank teller counter in the lower-left foreground, dwarfed. The customer is an anonymous foreground figure: This prominent foreground figure is an anonymous, non-recurring person drawn on the FULL base family rig — round near-circle head, NO nose, NO ears, classic cartoon hands (three fingers plus one thumb), even medium-thick #241a12 outline, clean flat cel render — a plain modern customer in ordinary clothes, hold ONLY the rig form. Warm teal bank palette, cream forms, one red accent on a single overdue-slip clipped to the pile. Clean flat 2.5D vector cartoon in The Second Take house style: even medium-thick dark warm brown-black (#241a12) outline on everything, flat cel colours with gentle soft cel shading and genuine fore/mid/background depth (never flat or empty), rounded friendly shapes, no realistic detail; built-but-flat environment filled edge-to-edge; any in-world lettering hand-lettered in the marker style, short and legible; locked 2-3 colour scene palette plus the single red accent #d7402b used only semantically; no photorealism, no on-screen narrator or host face, no unrequested text, no logos; 16:9.
